description: en->ja acceptance fixture (roadmap step 5). Japanese target: the ja locale profile applies (13 full-width characters per line, half-width counts 0.5, 4 cps, kinsoku). Expected breaks worked out by hand: a two-line break that never starts a line with a small kana, a prolonged sound mark or closing punctuation. Among legal breaks, one after a particle (hiragana followed by kanji/katakana) is preferred, then the shortest longer line.
